title: File:Sto. Tomas de Villanueva Parish Church.jpg
date: Taken on 15 September 2024, 06:44:34 (according to Exif data)
description: The church was administered by the Augustinian Recollects as early as 1621, It became an independent parish in 1742, marking its formal recognition as a distinct religious community. St. Thomas of Villanova, A Spanish saint known for his charity and humility. The church remains a vital spiritual center for Danao City, Cebu, hosting regular masses, feast day celebrations, and community events. It is a landmark of faith and heritage, reflecting centuries of devotion and resilience.

description: Wheels on ordinary roads is no longer a challenging coarse for this riders.
